maya: Morning one-liner sprint: Describe your commute in one absurd sentence.

owen: Rode a subway that only played motivational hold music.

tara: My bike took a detour to demand respect. :biking_woman:

maya: @owen wow that is peak New York.

zane: I convoyed with three scooters and a very opinionated pigeon.

ops-bot: FYI: Kitchen shelves reorganized 09:15. Labels updated. Please return mugs to "home".

owen: kudos to whoever labeled the "Emergency snacks" (I broke protocol and opened them already). :seedling:

tara: Shoutout to @maya for finding the missing whiteboard marker. You are forever honored.

maya: I'll accept the honor and the sticky note shrine.

zane: Two-word status I loved today: "commuter philosopher".

maya: Vote: croissant democracy or banana republic for Friday treats? React with :croissant: or :banana:.

owen: :croissant: because buttery diplomacy is the best diplomacy.

tara: :banana: low-mess, high-speed.

ops-bot: Poll update: croissant 57%, banana 43% (n=7).

zane: Also minor PSA: plant near window needs water. If it talks back, it's probably me.

maya: Thread sealed with one-liners and loose crumbs. Thanks team!
